title: Newmark Arranges Sale and Financing of Cascades Marketplace in Loudoun County, Virginia
summary: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale and financing for Cascades Marketplace, a 217,946-square-foot grocery-anchored shopping center in Sterling, Virginia.
body_markdown: Newmark announces the Company has arranged the sale and financing for Cascades Marketplace, a 217,946-square-foot grocery-anchored shopping center in Sterling, Virginia.
